items.title: Sandisk Stock Is Getting Its Mojo Back Amid China Memory-Chip Move
items.summary: Sandisk  stock is on a hot streak and may finally be getting its mojo back.  The shares are on a five-day winning streak through Friday, jumping 35% in that time.  Sandisk was moving in tandem with other memory stocks, including  Western Digital Seagate  and  Micron  ahead of the open Monday.

items.title: What Does Western Digital (WDC) Signal With A $93.9 Billion Spin Off Backlog?
items.summary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) spin off SanDisk outlined a US$93.9b customer backlog at its recent Investor Day following its separation from the parent company. SanDisk is targeting 80% margins through 2030, with management linking the outlook to demand for AI related storage solutions. The SanDisk update gives Western Digital investors fresh context on how the split is reshaping exposure to higher margin storage opportunities.
